221 void MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection(void)
222 {
223  int32_t retVal;
224  uint32_t msg = 0;
225 
226  uint32_t subFrameCnt = 0;
227 
228  while(1)
229  {
230  switch(gDPCState)
231  {
232  case MMWDEMO_DPC_COMMONCFG:
233  {
234  /* Wait for the common cfg to be available. */
235  SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCStateSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
236  retVal = DPC_ObjectDetection_ioctl( gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle,
237  DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG,
238  gMsgBuf, sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg));
239  if(retVal<0)
240  {
241  DebugP_log("DPC Error:%d\n", retVal);
242  DebugP_assert(0);
243  }
244 
245  subFrameCnt = gObjDetObj.commonCfg.numSubFrames;
246 
247  /* Update the sensor state */
248  gDPCState = MMWDEMO_DPC_CFG;
249 
250  /* Send the common cfg to MSS for Elevation estimation */
251  retVal = DPM_send(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(gMsgBuf), sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstCommonCfg), CSL_CORE_ID_R5FSS0_0);
252  DebugP_assert(0 == retVal);
253  break;
254  }
255 
256  case MMWDEMO_DPC_CFG:
257  {
258  /* Wait for the preStart Cfg to be available */
259  SemaphoreP_pend(&gDPCStateSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
260  retVal = DPC_ObjectDetection_ioctl( gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle,
261  DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_CFG,
262  gMsgBuf, sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg));
263  if(retVal<0)
264  {
265  DebugP_log("DPC Error:%d\n", retVal);
266  DebugP_assert(0);
267  }
268 
269  if(subFrameCnt <= 1U)
270  {
271  /* config done, start the DPC */
272  retVal = DPC_ObjectDetection_start(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle);
273  if(retVal<0)
274  {
275  DebugP_log("DPC Error:%d\n", retVal);
276  DebugP_assert(0);
277  }
278 
279  /* Update the sensor state */
280  gDPCState = MMWDEMO_DPC_EXECUTE;
281  }
282  else
283  {
284  subFrameCnt--;
285  }
286 
287  /* Send the subframe specific configuration for elevation estimation */
288  retVal = DPM_send(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(gMsgBuf), sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ElevEstSubframeCfg), CSL_CORE_ID_R5FSS0_0);
289  DebugP_assert(0 == retVal);
290  break;
291  }
292 
293  case MMWDEMO_DPC_EXECUTE:
294  /* Process the ADC Data and get the detected objects. */
295  retVal = DPC_ObjectDetection_execute(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle, &resultBuffer);
296  if(retVal<0)
297  {
298  DebugP_log("DPC Error:%d\n", retVal);
299  DebugP_assert(0);
300  }
301 
302  /* Notify the DSS that M4 Results are ready and it can start angle estimation. */
303  msg = MMWDEMO_DPC_RESULT;
304 #if MSS_AOA_ENABLED
305  retVal = DPM_send(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(&msg), sizeof(uint32_t), CSL_CORE_ID_R5FSS0_0);
306 #else
307  retVal = DPM_send(gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, (void*)(&msg), sizeof(uint32_t), CSL_CORE_ID_C66SS0);
308 #endif
309  DebugP_assert(0 == retVal);
310  break;
311  default:
312  DebugP_assert(0);
313  }
314  }
315 }

326 int main (void)
327 {
328  int32_t errCode;
329  DPM_InitCfg dpmInitCfg;
330  DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams objDetInitParams;
331  HwiP_Params hwiPrms;
332 #if SOC_AWR2x44LC
333  uint32_t syncStatusRefVal = CSL_FMKR(DPM_DSS_CM4_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, DPM_MSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, 3U);
334 #else
335  uint32_t syncStatusRefVal = CSL_FMKR(DPM_DSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, DPM_MSS_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS, 7U);
336 #endif
337 
338  /* init SOC specific modules */
339  System_init();
340  Board_init();
341 
342  /* Initialize the demo MCB */
343  memset ((void*)&gMmwDssCM4MCB, 0, sizeof(gMmwDssCM4MCB));
344 
345  CycleCounterP_reset();
346 
347  Drivers_open();
348  /* Open the HWA Instance */
349  gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.hwaHandle = HWA_open(0, NULL, &errCode);
350  if (gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.hwaHandle == NULL)
351  {
352  DebugP_log ("Error: Unable to open the HWA [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
353  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
354  }
355  gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.edmaHandle = gEdmaHandle[0];
356 
357  /* Initialization of the DPM Module: */
358 
359  memset ((void *)&dpmInitCfg, 0, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
360  /* Setup the configuration: */
361  dpmInitCfg.localEndPt = gRemoteCoreEndPt[CSL_CORE_ID_M4SS0_1];
362  dpmInitCfg.reportFxn = MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn;
363  dpmInitCfg.setBitPos = DPM_DSS_CM4_BOOT_INFO_BIT_POS;
364 
365  gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle = DPM_init(&dpmInitCfg, &errCode);
366  if (gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle == NULL)
367  {
368  DebugP_log ("Error: Unable to initialize the DPM Module [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
369  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
370  return errCode;
371  }
372 
373  /* Initialization of the DPC Module */
374  memset ((void *)&objDetInitParams, 0, sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams));
375 
376  /* Note this must be after MmwDemo_dataPathOpen() above which opens the hwa */
377  objDetInitParams.hwaHandle = gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.hwaHandle;
378  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.addr = (void *)gMmwL3;
379  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.size = DSS_L3_U_SIZE;
380  objDetInitParams.L3ramCfg.endSize = DSS_L3_U_SIZE - DSS_L3_CODE_END;
381  objDetInitParams.CoreLocalRamCfg.addr = &gDPC_ObjDetL2Heap[0];
382  objDetInitParams.CoreLocalRamCfg.size = sizeof(gDPC_ObjDetL2Heap);
383  objDetInitParams.edmaHandle[0] = gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.edmaHandle;
384 
385  gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle = DPC_ObjectDetection_init (&objDetInitParams, &errCode);
386  if (gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle == NULL)
387  {
388  DebugP_log ("Error: Unable to initialize the DPC [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
389  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
390  return errCode;
391  }
392 
393  /* Synchronization: This will synchronize the execution of the control module
394  * between the domains. This is a prerequiste and always needs to be invoked. */
395  while (1)
396  {
397  int32_t syncStatus;
398 
399  /* Get the synchronization status: */
400  syncStatus = DPM_synch (gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpmHandle, &errCode);
401  if (syncStatus < 0)
402  {
403  /* Error: Unable to synchronize the framework */
404  DebugP_log ("Error: DPM Synchronization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
405  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
406  return errCode;
407  }
408  if ((uint32_t)syncStatus == syncStatusRefVal)
409  {
410  /* Synchronization acheived: */
411  break;
412  }
413  /* Sleep and poll again: */
414  ClockP_usleep(1U * 1000U);
415  }
416 
417  /* Register Frame Start Interrupt */
418  HwiP_Params_init(&hwiPrms);
419  hwiPrms.intNum = CSL_CM4_INTR_DFE_FRAME_START_TO_MSS;
420  hwiPrms.callback = &DPC_ObjectDetection_frameStart;
421  hwiPrms.args = (void*)gMmwDssCM4MCB.dataPathObj.objDetDpcHandle;
422  errCode = HwiP_construct(&MMwDemo_FrameStartHwiObject, &hwiPrms);
423  if (SystemP_SUCCESS != errCode)
424  {
425  DebugP_log ("Error: Frame Start Interrupt Registration failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
426  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
427  return errCode;
428  }
429  else
430  {
431  HwiP_enableInt((uint32_t)hwiPrms.intNum);
432  }
433 
434  /* Create the Semaphore to wait in a particular Sensor State */
435  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gDPCStateSemHandle, 0);
436 
437  /* Initial DPC state is to wait for common configurations from MSS. */
438  gDPCState = MMWDEMO_DPC_COMMONCFG;
439 
440  /* Program should never return from this function call. */
441  MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection();
442 
443  return 0;
444 }
